verdict.rationale: A business-formation and compliance SaaS could plausibly offer an API or CLI for headless or CI automation, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only dashboard and in-app workflows. The lone "Advanced API integrations" line on the pricing page is an unexplained bookkeeping-tier feature, not a documented way to drive the product programmatically. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, so there is no evidence of headless or CI operation.
